items.text: Our new update is live! This version focuses on the drag race scene, the vehicle auction interface, lighting improvements during customization, and many technical upgrades based on your feedback.
Here are the full details: 👇
The drag race scene has been completely revamped.
The race distance is now randomly selected within a specific range.
The vehicle auction interface has been redesigned to be more user-friendly.
Special lighting has been added during vehicle customization to better see parts.
The texture memory budget has been increased. We recommend testing performance on low-end PCs.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/330d0b3607f955da183c437f069574b26b3e6e9d.png"]
Fixed a crash issue.
Fixed first-person camera problem with the Supra vehicle.
Resolved a terrain glitch at the port area.
Fixed the duplicate purchase warning when buying a car in the Luxury section.
Corrected the arrow rotation bug in the vehicle pricing interface (especially when price is set to 0).
"Year" label now appears correctly translated on the vehicle sale screen.
Fixed the issue where two currencies were shown in the same spot.
Fixed clone-like animation behavior of seated NPCs in auctions.
Resolved disappearing characters in the auction scene.
Warning panel in the vehicle storage now properly closes when the pause menu is opened.
Lights, exhaust effects and vehicle behavior in drag races now match the main map.
Tutorial translations were corrected.
Resolved warning message overflow during crashes.
Fixed the issue where "customer missed" warnings repeated unnecessarily.
Increased sound volume for low-audio vehicles.
Unity engine updated to version 6.2.6 for security reasons.
Construction site sounds in the neighborhood could be heard everywhere, this has been fixed.
Fixed issues with drifting AI when manual transmission was enabled.
Rissan GR3 vehicle no longer comes with a default race kit.
Corrected camera angle issues for license plates in customization.
Fixed loading delay in the vehicle storage area.
Improved the system for resetting broken save files when corruption is detected.
Share your feedback and help us improve the game together! ❤️

items.text: Hello players! With this update, we’ve fixed the major issues you reported and made your gameplay experience more stable. You can see the applied fixes below:
1. Showroom and Vehicle Management
Issue: When you deleted a showroom while it still contained a vehicle, that vehicle would disappear as well.
Fix: Deleting a showroom now only removes the showroom object; vehicles stored inside remain safe in your depot.
2. PSO TRACE Mouse Stuttering
Issue: Mouse movements would stutter while playing in PSO TRACE mode.
Fix: Optimized the interaction between PSO TRACE and the mouse; mouse movements are now smooth.
3. Office, Caravan, and House Add-On Errors
Issue: Certain add-ons for offices, caravans, or houses (for example, changing the house color) were producing errors.
Fix: Reviewed all office/caravan/house add-ons; color settings and other customizations now display correctly.
4. Car Auction Error Trigger
Issue: In the “Car Auction” screen, clicking on a buyer would trigger an error if there were vehicles in your depot.
Fix: Improved the auction entry logic to check for vehicles properly; no errors now occur even when you have cars stored.
5. Saved Game (Save) File Errors
Issue 5.1: When loading save files from before a map change, the game would throw an error and fail to start.
Fix: Added a patch that detects old map formats and applies the necessary conversion. Save files from before the map change now load without issues.
Issue 5.2: Players with older-version save files encountered errors when opening the game.
Fix: Restored full backward compatibility for all previous-version save files. Older saves load properly so you can continue your progress seamlessly.
6. Drag Race Transition Animation Error
Issue: Transitioning to the “Drag Race” screen would trigger an error during the money-text animation.
Fix: Reworked the money animation code; transitioning into a Drag Race now plays the animation smoothly without errors.
Note: All of the above fixes have been thoroughly tested based on your feedback. If you encounter any other issues or have suggestions, please let us know. Enjoy the game!
In the past, when you first started the game, all vehicle data would load onto your computer at once. This often caused long wait times. Now, we load each car only when you actually need it.
How does this help? The loading time is reduced when you enter the game. Vehicles appear much faster when you browse the menu or switch to a new map.

notes.title: 2. Smaller Updates When You Have Internet Connection

items.text: If there’s an update on Steam, instead of downloading the entire vehicle pack again, we only download the small pieces that have changed.
How does this help? Ongoing updates take up less space and download more quickly. When we add a new car or fix visuals on a model, the update size stays small, so the download time is shorter.

notes.title: 3. Uses Less Memory (RAM) on Your Computer

items.text: Because not all cars are loaded into memory at the same time, your computer can run more smoothly while you play.
How does this help? If you play for a long time or change maps, you’re less likely to experience stuttering or lag. This makes the overall experience more fluid and enjoyable.

notes.title: 4. We Can Add New Cars Instantly

items.text: When our development team creates new cars, new skins, or extra add-ons, those items become available automatically as soon as you update the game. This means:
You can use new vehicles without needing to download a massive file.
If we only change a few models, only those model files get updated.

items.text: Thanks to your support, our community is growing every day, and we’re continuing to deliver even more exciting experiences. Remember, this is just the beginning. In our next update, we will bring you new DLC, bug fixes, and visual improvements.
We are thrilled to announce our latest feature: The Car Theft System!
With this update, you can take the automotive trade world to an entirely new level. As a car dealer, you can now choose a darker and riskier path to seize opportunities.

To steal cars, you’ll need lockpicks, which can now be purchased from the black market. Finding the black market might take some effort, but once you gain access, you’re ready for your car theft adventure.

Some vehicles will be available for theft during nighttime in neighborhoods. Stealable cars will be marked with a key symbol next to them. However, don’t get too excited when you see this symbol; without a lockpick, you can’t begin the operation. Here’s where your skills come into play:
The car theft process will be performed through a mini-game.
Use the lockpick to align the green boxes.
If successful, you’ll have a stolen car in your hands!

notes.title: Risk of Getting Caught by Police 👮‍♂️

items.text: Stealing cars is a risky business! A failed lockpick attempt can draw the police’s attention. Additionally, your office where stolen cars are stored can also be at risk:
Police inspections of your office will occur on certain days of the week.
If stolen cars are found in your office, getting caught is inevitable.
If caught by the police, you will face fines and severe economic consequences.
You can sell the cars you successfully steal at your office. But be cautious! Keeping stolen cars in your office can attract police attention and complicate your business.
If caught by the police, your stolen cars will be confiscated, and you’ll suffer significant financial setbacks. So, think carefully about the risks and plan your moves strategically.
But remember, every action has a cost! How far can your courage and wit take you against the risk of getting caught? 🚔

items.text: Dear Players
As the Car for Sale Simulator 2023 family, we have exciting news for you!

With the new drift map now added to our game, your driving experience will be much more adrenalized and exciting. This map has been specially designed to meet the expectations of drift enthusiasts and will give you unforgettable moments.

One of the biggest innovations that come with the update is the major changes in the vehicle system. New driving dynamics and improvements to the drifting abilities in particular offer players a more realistic and enjoyable driving experience. The handling and control you will now feel while driving the vehicles goes beyond previous experiences. Moreover, we've improved the quality of the sound, so you'll be immersed in the game in a more realistic and immersive way.

But the exciting innovations don't stop there! With the New Year's Eve event, the map of Car for Sale Simulator 2023 has been transformed into a snowy winter season. This atmospheric change is not only visual, but also a special competition with various gifts hidden on the map awaits you. In this magical atmosphere of winter, you can participate in races and enjoy surprise prizes. Join us for an unforgettable Christmas experience and discover this fun event.

items.text: Version 0.2.6 Patch Notes

This update brings significant changes and additions to enhance your gaming experience. If you want to see all these processes, test the game in advance, or assist us, feel free to join our Discord channel.

items.text: Dear Car For Sale Simulator 2023 Community,
Hello everyone! Unfortunately, we regret to inform you that we won't be able to deliver the office update as planned.
This month, we've been working tirelessly on the game, pushing out all the updates we had planned except for the office update.

While developing the office build system update, we've encountered some unexpected errors and issues. Ensuring the quality and stability of the game is our top priority, and therefore, we've decided that these issues need to be resolved and thoroughly reviewed. We believe taking this step is essential to provide the best experience for our players.

Although this decision necessitates a delay, it will ultimately contribute to a better and smoother update of the game in the long run. As a team, we're working diligently to complete this process as soon as possible and eagerly anticipating delivering the best gaming experience to all of you.

We are grateful for your understanding regarding our shortcomings and the necessity to hold back. We will continue to provide you with the latest updates and progress. Please continue to follow our official social media accounts and Steam community page.
We plan to release the office update as a beta in the first week of September, followed by the full update in the second week of September.
Best regards,

releases.displayName: UPDATE # Bug Fixes, New Office, and Scrapyard System News

items.text: Hello, we have been addressing and dealing with issues such as the game not launching, crashing, and getting stuck on a black screen, which were occurring in a very small number of players.
The crashing issue that some players were experiencing has been resolved.
The freezing problem during the loading screen that some players encountered while the game was loading has been fixed.
The issue of the game getting stuck on a black screen during transitions between track maps has been resolved.
However, despite ongoing developments in the background, we wanted to showcase the construction process of our future new office that we shared with you through our Discord server.

We are making significant improvements to the scrapyard system. In a nutshell, we will now have the ability to purchase scrap vehicles. However, our goal is not just to repair and sell these vehicles in a normal way, but to do something different.
Note: These updates have not been implemented yet. We wanted to provide information about upcoming updates.

Here's how it works: In the scrapyard, you inspect and purchase damaged vehicles. However, since these vehicles are heavily damaged, they are currently unusable and require specific parts to function. You have the chance to find these parts in the scrapyard or buy them from someone who sells car parts. Each vehicle will have its own unique parts, so you'll need to find the parts specific to the brand of the vehicle you purchased. Once you have completed the parts, you can start using the vehicle, but it will still require repairs, so it will only move very slowly and be able to go to the repair shop. After taking the car to the repair shop, the mechanic will ask you for specific parts again, and once you provide them, your vehicle will be repaired. Then, if you wish, you can perform painting or cleaning procedures.
Along with this system, an inventory system is also being introduced into the game. You will be able to see the parts you collect or purchase in the inventory.
